race.description: Bribie Island Rsl - Raaf Mdn Plate
race.comment: BRASS BAND (1) went close to shedding the maiden tag last time, sitting on the pace and kicking strongly to finish second over 1666m at Ipswich. Will find this a little easier than last time and looks the one they all have to run down. SONIC FLYER (10) returned last time and finished fourth at Warwick over 1350m, beaten only 1.2 lengths. Can come on from that run and looks a serious contender. IN THE HOLE TIGER (2) finished sixth, beaten 3 lengths, when resuming from a spell last start over 1350m at Warwick. Will derive great benefit from that outing and deserves consideration. RUBICK'S SHADOW (5) was in contention on the corner and finished third last start over 1500m at this track, beaten 2.25 lengths. Fitter for that run. In the right race and is one of the better hopes.
